g.text: Basic: the agent chat contract
71 scenarios in 11 rules. 57 are @must, the floor. 14 @should, 6 @agent.
@must
@should
@agent
Scroll follows the reader, never the
stream
Following the stream while at the bottom
Reading history while the agent streams
A scroll-wheel up releases the pin at once
Scrolling up during a real reply is never
pulled back
A way back to the newest message
Opening a conversation lands at the bottom
Older history pages in without a jump
An existing conversation never flashes the
empty state
My own message always pins
The composer keeps what I type
Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks a line, on
desktop
Enter during IME composition never sends
On a phone, Enter is a newline
The shortcut is written down
The composer is focused and ready on load
The composer grows with the text, up to a
limit
Send is disabled for empty input, and says
why
A send that cannot go out keeps the draft
The draft survives a reload or a deploy
Typing hides the starter prompts
Paste an image
Locked features say why they are locked
A running turn is visible, timed, and
stoppable
Send becomes Stop
Esc stops the agent
A thinking indicator appears only when it is
needed
Each tool call shows a live timer
agent
The whole task shows a live timer
agent
A stuck tool row never runs forever
agent
A turn that ends with nothing visible says
so
Reasoning is folded
agent
Tool rows keep their open or closed state
while streaming
The conversation list tells me what
needs me
A new chat appears in the list at once
Each chat shows whether it is working
Each chat shows working, idle, or failed at
a glance
agent
The list is grouped by time and searchable
Pin, archive, and rename from the row
Delete asks first
Messages have actions where I need them
Copy a message
Copy a code block
Retry, edit, and branch
Code is highlighted without blocking the
first token
Connection state is truthful
Reconnecting is shown, then gives up
honestly
A stale close cannot undo a good connection
A backgrounded tab catches up when it
returns
A turn interrupted by a restart resumes
agent
Notices are placed in time, not pinned
on top
Errors sit in the transcript in order
A long error is summarised, with detail on
demand
Side panels fit the reader's screen
A details pane opens for what I picked, and
only then
A side panel can be hidden and shown again
A side panel can be resized on desktop
Panel sizes and visibility survive a reload
What is inside a panel adapts to its width
On a phone, side panels open over the
conversation
Each panel toggle has a keyboard shortcut
A double click on the drag edge restores the
default width
Signing in and out is plain and complete
A signed-out visitor sees one way in
The API refuses a caller who is not signed
in
The first sign-in asks only what it needs,
then lands somewhere useful
A cancelled or failed sign-in says why
Who I am is always one click away
Signing out is one visible control
After signing out, nothing private is
reachable
Signing out revokes what the app was granted
An expired session sends me to sign in,
keeping my place
The page works for everyone
The transcript is a polite live region
Motion respects the system setting
Every icon button has a name
No text sits on top of other text
Notifications have a keyboard shortcut
The first screen invites a first message
The empty state offers starters
Starters belong to the owner
The copy names the outcome, not the feature
